apply.signIn: Sign in to apply settings via the mod
apply.title: Apply via the mod
apply.description: Pick the groups. The mod shows the changes in the hangar and applies them only after you confirm.
apply.resolutionHint: Depend on the monitor, so they are not copied by default.
apply.sensitivityHint: Depends on the mouse and DPI, so it is not copied by default.

notes.hangar: Applied only in the hangar, never in battle.
notes.noUndo: The mod keeps no copy of your previous settings: you can only change them back by hand in the game settings.

apply.sent: Request sent. Open the hangar — the mod will list the changes.
apply.failed: Could not send the request. Check that the mod is installed and linked to your account.

list.title: Streamer settings
list.description: Sensitivity, FOV, graphics, zoom and modpacks of Mir Tankov creators. Facts with a source link, no rehosted files.

table.caption: Streamer settings
table.emptyDescription: Settings appear here as soon as creators publish them.
table.noMatchDescription: Change the search or the preset.

aggregates.title: What top players use
aggregates.emptyDescription: A group shows once at least {min} people have shared their settings.
aggregates.privacy: Settings of regular players count only anonymously and are never shown individually.

share.title: My settings from the mod
share.emptyDescription: You have not shared your settings yet. Here is how:

steps.install: Install our mod and link it to your account.
steps.hangar: In the hangar, press “Send game settings to the site” in the mod window.
steps.target: Choose “Only for me” and, if you like, turn on “Count my settings in anonymous statistics”.

share.anonymousHint: Your values go only into the shared distributions, without your nickname or account.
share.removeDescription: Your settings from the mod will be removed from the site and from the statistics.

compare.title: Compare settings
compare.description: Up to four creators and, optionally, your own settings from the mod — at least two columns. Differences are highlighted.
compare.noShareDescription: Send them from the mod window in the hangar with “Send game settings to the site”.
compare.emptyDescription: Add creators (up to {max}) or your own settings — at least {min} columns.
compare.noValues: The selected creators have no settings in common
